title: 日本語の森 N2 — 上級敬語と複合語 (Advanced Keigo and Compound Expressions)
description: From 日本語の森. This N2 lesson covers advanced honorific patterns found in business Japanese: ～ていただく vs ～てもらう nuances, the use of お/ご+verb stem constructions, and compound humble expressions (ご連絡させていただきます). Includes email and phone-call examples.
